description: This file defines the WriteRequestBatch class used for batching and sending batch write requests (put and delete) to Amazon DynamoDB via the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles queuing, batching, auto-flushing, and re-queuing unprocessed items to ensure efficient and reliable batch write operations.

classes.name: WriteRequestBatch
classes.description: A class for efficiently batching, sending, and retrying DynamoDB BatchWriteItem requests, supporting features like auto-flushing, custom configuration, and handling unprocessed items.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the batch with a DynamoDbClient, configuration options such as batch size, pool size, auto-flush, and optional callbacks, validating input parameters.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Queues an item for insertion into DynamoDB, with optional table override, and triggers auto-flush if enabled.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Queues a delete request for an item identified by its key, with optional table override, and triggers auto-flush if enabled.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Sends all queued write requests in batches, retrying unprocessed items, and optionally continues until the queue is empty.

methods.name: prepareCommands
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of BatchWriteItem commands from the queued requests, chunked by batch size.

methods.name: retryUnprocessed
methods.description: Re-queues unprocessed items received from DynamoDB responses for subsequent retry attempts.

methods.name: autoFlush
methods.description: Triggers flushing the queue if autoflush is enabled and the request count exceeds the threshold.

methods.name: determineTable
methods.description: Determines the appropriate table name for a request, using the provided table name or default configuration, throwing if none specified.
